user.title: Connect Homi
user.description: Create a scoped API key in Homi Settings. Recommended scopes: home:read, assets:read, maintenance:write and repairs:write.

data_description.url: The public or local base URL of your Homi instance.
data_description.api_key: A scoped, revocable Homi API key.
data_description.home_id: The UUID of the Homi home to expose in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or lacks the required scope.

abort.already_configured: This Homi home is already configured.
